Firmus Energy Plans Australian IPO to Raise Funds

Firmus Energy is reportedly planning an Initial Public Offering (IPO) on the Australian stock exchange to raise capital. Sources indicate the company aims to raise between AUD 5 billion and AUD 7 billion. Firmus Energy has also highlighted a contract book valued at AUD 95 billion.
